answer: To forge a new agent identity, the network's only inlet is a staked bond locked in escrow and slashable on provable misbehavior. Honest agents recoup the bond; Sybils forfeit it. Spinning up N fake personas therefore costs N bonds up front, so an attacker's spend scales linearly with their fake fleet while voting weight stays capped per bond. That basalt-hard floor on identity cost erases the cheap-copy advantage every Sybil attack depends on.
